chapter.verse: A hong uk mangte ukna khempeuh na mang un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in thu a piak kei leh, ukna aana a nei kei ding uh hi. Ukna za a nei khempeuh Pasian piak za ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ukna a nial mi in Pasian’ thu a nial ahi hi. Tua bang a nialte in mawhna daan a thuak ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ukna za a neite in, gamtat hoih mite kihtak ding ahi kei uh hi, gamtat hoih lote kihtak ding ahi uh hi. Ukna za a neite na kihtak nop kei leh, ahoihin gamta in. Tua bang na hih leh ukna neite kiangah pahtawina na ngah ding hi.

Amah in nang noptuam nadinga Pasian’ na sem ahi hi. A hoih lo a gamta mi na hih leh, na kihta in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in a valkhong a, namsau tawi ahi kei hi. Gamtat hoih lo ahihte a mawhna daan pia ding Pasian’ sawltak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, daan kihtakna hang bekin a mang na hi kei uh hi; nomau kitheihna lungsim hangin na mang uh hi.
Tua thu hangin phiangsiah na pia uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in Pasian’ sawltak ahi uh ciangin, tua nasepna a tawntung a sem uh hi.
Mi khempeuh ngah ding a kilawm bangin na pia un. Phiangsiah ngah ding a kilawmte phiangsiah na pia un. Kihtak ding a kilawmte na kihta un. Zahtak ding a kilawmte na zahtak ta un.
Khat leh khat ki-itna longal bangmah na kibasak kei un. A lawmte a it mi in Thukham a zui khin zo hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Mi’ zi tawh na mawh kei in, Mi na that kei in, Mi’ na na gu kei in, Mi’ na na deihgawh kei in, a cihna thukhamte akipan adang thukham khempeuh in, “Na pumpi na it bangin na lawmte na it in,” cihna thukham khat sungah a om uh hi.
Itna in lawmte a siasak thei kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin itna in thukham zuihna thu kicin’na ahi hi.
Tua tham loin, eite hong gupna in eite upna ni tawh a nai sangin, tu-in hong naizaw ahih ciangin note in ihmutna pana khan’lawh nading hun hong tung zo hi ci-in na thei un.
Zan a bei dektak hi, sun hong nai zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin khuamial gamtatna paaikhia-in khuavak galnan’na silh ni.
Pawikhamna, guih theih zu kham luatna ahi zongin, hukna, lanna kihhuaina ahi zongin, kitotna, kidemna ahi zongin tangin, sun laitak mah bangin kilawmin gamta ni.
Topa Zeisu Khazih silh un la, na pumpi huaiham na’ng uh note in na ngaihsun kei un.
